The excess between leaving (fix 68) and rejoining (fix 162) the corridor is 6.350 km and is excluded; residual excess 6.370 - 6.350 = 0.020 km fails both POL-RD-01 tests, so no driver deviation survives. doubts: (1) Measure of 'unbilled kilometres': the limb compares billed distance with the whole gps_trace (6.370 km -> 4.80); restricting to the rider-requested spur (6.350 km -> 4.7625 -> 4.80) gives the same payable figure, so the ambiguity is immaterial here. Using the rounded trip_record 20.6 km would give 6.40 x 0.75 = 4.80 too. (2) A reader could treat the driver's SGD 6.00 as the contested amount and think of a PARTIAL outcome, but POL-GEN-03 gives DRIVER_COMPENSATION as the ruling value when the driver is owed money. (3) 'may be granted' in POL-RD-04 is permissive; I read it as granted where its arithmetic conditions are met on an uncontradicted, rider-admitted request. An alternative reading treating the fixed upfront fare as allocating the risk to the driver would give NO_ACTION, but POL-RD-11 expressly routes rider-requested detours on upfront trips to POL-RD-04 compensation.
